name: Antoku-tei
source:
Emperor Antoku was the son of Emperor Takakura and grandson of Kiyomori.

He is the youngest emperor in history, ascending to the throne at the age of three.

Although he is the youngest emperor in history, he is still a child with a pure and honest character.

Munemori and a nun of the second rank are actively taking care of him. Munemori seems to be a little overprotective of him.
